games.name: Combat Tower Obby [Abyss of Pain]
games.desc:
An obby game inspired by Tower of Hell, but here, instead of climbing up, you jump down and have access to weapons and items to sabotage and troll other players.

Dive into the ultimate Roblox obby challenge where you race downward through insane obstacles! Reach the bottom of the tower before the clock runs out. 
Engage in battles with other players as you descend, testing your reflexes and strategy against both the environment and human enemies.

Plot your course, there are multiple paths you can take to get to the bottom floor.
Earn coins and gems to buy items & weapons to knock opponents down, sabotage their progress, and be the first to reach the bottom. 
Dodge traps, fight enemies, and master crazy jumps in the chaotic descent.

The tower is randomly generated, with obby stages of different difficulty ranging from easy to hard to impossible.

Escape the Abyss to earn rewards and buffs to troll other players.

Be sure to like 👍 and favourite ⭐ for new obby stages and updates.

games.desc:
Venice 1939, rumors of blood-sucking monsters beginning to spread around the area. Something within you demands answers.

>> This is a 3 life perma-death progression based PvPvE game inspired by the first two parts in the manga JoJo's Bizarre Adventure by Hirohiko Araki, enter at your own risk. 👀 <<

DEFAULT CONTROLS;
M1: Light Punch
M2: Heavy Punch
Double Tap W/Ctrl: Sprint
Q: Dash
Sprinting + Space: Dive
Double Tap Space (With Hamon Breathing): Hamon Climb
Hold Space (Undead): Super Jump
G: Charge Hamon
E: Secondary
R: Tertiary

Type ":CMDS" for Commands List
Press Tab to open Inventory & Masteries (Combat tool may spawn in it sometimes)

! Join our Game Community Server for progress & upcoming release date !

Martial Grounds is a unique fighting game inspired by "Absolver".
The game offers a bunch of fighting styles each have their own unique Style Ability and passive.
The main part of the game is Deck Building, think of it as making your own moveset with over 200+ punches and kicks to choose from.
Gear up, Survive, fight, or just... hangout

Under revamp.

"Step into a rowdy frontier town where every brawl holds a tale."

M1 = Punch
E = Kick
M2 / Left CTRL = Alternate Toggle (For Attacks & Special Abilities)

H = Emotes
